metrics: Exact responses permit surrounding whitespace only. JSON is parsed without fence removal. Base completion models are not scored on instruction cases. Determinism and stop/cancellation have separate runtime checks. Bounded retrieval uses 128 filler words, not a maximum-context claim. v2 preserves every prompt and expected answer; only task budgets and failure classification change. Nonempty explanation/completion checks remain limited surface checks, not semantic evaluation.
